subject.title: fix: external plugin tabs fail under gateway auth

question: May a plugin-tab browser credential remain usable for up to five minutes after gateway credential or device revocation and authorize all gateway-auth plugin routes, or must it be route-bound and tied to current authorization state?
rationale: The repository establishes per-request authorization and credential-rotation behavior, but it does not define an existing public contract for an ambient browser credential spanning all protected plugin routes.

options.title: Bind the launch grant
options.body: Include the selected plugin route and a revocable gateway authorization generation in the signed grant, then reject mismatched or stale grants.

options.title: Accept bounded ambient authority
options.body: Explicitly approve the five-minute all-plugin-route credential as an intentional trusted-plugin security tradeoff and add tests and documentation for revocation delay.

recommendation.title: Bind the launch grant
recommendation.body: Include the selected plugin route and a revocable gateway authorization generation in the signed grant, then reject mismatched or stale grants.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the Control UI HTTP authentication and credential-rotation behavior that this decision changes.
